name: Fuobe push-in

dataset.what: Own-shot push-in clips: a steady dolly or zoom into the eyes or the mouth of people who signed a release; no text or logos in frame.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbpushin, " then says "slow push in to an extreme close-up of the eyes" or "… of the mouth" in the same words each time, then what is in the first frame.
One sentence for what moves and one for what stays still; no text, logos or names.

notes: Replaces the Wan 'eyes in' LoRA, which forbids selling outputs. fal's Wan 2.2 I2V trainer returns one file; loading it on both experts is unverified until the first run.
